The main map carries only byte1[7] and explains 0.7569, because a four-byte instruction has no byte 4 and the eight-byte form's verified map puts the 16 bit there. byte2[3] is where it lives at four bytes, found by flipping every bit of witness 1b000100 and asking the decoder: 1b000900 decodes as imm:16. Exact on all 4,702 of Apple's register-source instances; the 5 remaining carry byte3[3], which makes operand 2 an EXPRESSION, and in that mode the 16 bit is not read - which is what the main map's 'conditional' verdict was about.
